paper_title: SepLLM Accelerate Large Language Models by Compressing One Segment into   One Separator
caption: : Loss Ratio FLOPs
model_annotation: The plot illustrates loss ratio (in percent) as a function of compute measured in TFLOPs for five methods/settings, shown as multiple colored lines with markers. The x-axis is labeled “TFLOPs” and uses scientific-notation tick labels from 1e7 to 9e8 (ticks shown at 1e7, 2e7, 5e7, 1e8, 2e8, 3e8, 4e8, 5e8, 6e8, 7e8, 8e8, 9e8), with non-uniform spacing consistent with a logarithmic-style placement. The y-axis is labeled “Loss Ratio (%)” and is on a linear scale spanning roughly 94 to 100, with integer tick marks at 94, 95, 96, 97, 98, 99, and 100. The “Vanilla” series is a purple solid line with upward-triangle markers that stays flat at 100% across all x values. “SepLLM (n=64)” is an orange solid line with plus markers that starts near 98.3% at 1e7, rises to about 100.1% at 2e8, reaches its highest point around 100.4% at 4e8, and ends just under 100% (about 99.9%) at 9e8. “SepLLM (n=128)” is a dark-blue solid line with x-shaped markers that increases from about 97.0% at 1e7 to about 99.9% at 2e8, sits around 100.0% at 4e8–5e8, and finishes around 99.8% at 9e8. “SepLLM (n=64, H)” is a green solid line with diamond markers that rises from about 97.5% at 1e7 to about 100.0% at 2e8, shows a small local high near 100.2% at 6e8, and ends around 99.9% at 9e8. “SepLLM (n=64, H/T)” is a red solid line with circular markers that climbs from about 94.0% at 1e7 to about 99.1% at 4e8, dips to roughly 98.5% at 5e8, returns to about 99.0% at 6e8–7e8, and ends near 98.7% at 9e8.
